description: Pure-managed compression streams (gzip / bzip2 / xz / zstd / brotli / lz4 / snappy / lzma / lzop / lrzip / and the long tail) and archive containers (zip / tar / 7z / rar / cab / wim / cpio / ar / xar / and the rest) plus software-package containers (apk / ipa / nupkg / deb / rpm / appx / msix / wheel / crate), Office Open XML / OpenDocument zip-bundles, comic-book archives, and the long tail of game / install-suite / Amiga / vintage formats. Self-contained bundle on top of Hawkynt.Compression.Core.
title: Hawkynt FileFormats Archives
